verdict.rationale: Anytype documents its own controls over where data is retained. It is stored locally on device, a local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely, self-hosting is supported, and export is possible at any time. The API also explicitly supports deleting files in spaces, which an AI-native workflow can drive programmatically. Deletion and retention controls themselves are thinly documented: there is no account or vault deletion and no retention policy in the evidence. missing for 10: documented account/vault deletion, purge of data from Anytype's backup node, configurable retention windows, object-level deletion via API/MCP, independent corroboration.
